articles.summary: Vision 2028 moves from investment to delivery as DRDGOLD positions for its next phase of growth Johannesburg, South Africa. 30 September 2026. DRDGOLD Limited (JSE: DRD, A2X: DRD, NYSE: DRD) has published its 2026 annual reporting suite following a year of strong financial performance, significant investment in Vision 2028 and continued progress towards the Group’s next phase of growth.
articles.title: DRDGOLD PUBLISHES 2026 REPORTING SUITE
